cases.input: Ein Grilling ist abgeschlossen. Danach folgen Research, Spezifikation, Implementierung, Review und Delivery. Im Verlauf entstehen PPTX, PDF und Exportbilder. Dokumentiere das Projekt in einem recipient-owned Google-Drive-Child-Brain und liefere die erzeugten Nicht-Code-Artefakte über verifizierte Drive-Links aus.
requiredBehaviors: initialize one canonical recipient-owned Google Drive project memory root after grilling
record semantic workflow transitions as linked events with canonical input output evidence references
keep generated non-code project and delivery artifacts under the owning Brain Drive root
register observed Drive file and folder identifiers in ASSETS state and related events after readback
return verified stored Drive links as the primary user-facing artifact handoff
forbiddenBehaviors: use GitHub local disk or sandbox as the canonical Brain runtime store
duplicate canonical producer truth into the Brain
invent Drive folder or file identifiers URLs or verification state
create a parallel Drive project folder for each downstream workflow
claim final document delivery while only a local or sandbox file exists

cases.input: Ein Softwareprojekt enthält PNG-Icons, Test-Fixtures und ein binäres Modell, die für Build, Tests oder Runtime erforderlich sind. Gleichzeitig erzeugt der Workflow einen PDF-Reviewreport und eine PPTX für das Steering Committee.
requiredBehaviors: keep repository-native build test runtime binary assets in the producer repository
store documentary PDF and PPTX artifacts in the owning Brain Drive root
reference producer repository evidence from the Drive Brain without duplicating executable content
return Drive links for the generated documentary artifacts
forbiddenBehaviors: move build test or runtime assets to Drive merely because they are binary
copy Drive deliverables back into GitHub as a second binary document store

cases.input: Das Grilling endet, bevor ein Child-Brain-Drive-Root feststeht. Später ist Google Drive vorübergehend nicht schreibbar, während lokal bereits eine finale EPUB gebaut wurde.
requiredBehaviors: prepare bootstrap state until a canonical recipient-owned Drive root exists
preserve the unavailable Drive write as pending or blocked
keep the local EPUB as a build intermediate rather than a final delivered artifact
avoid falling back to GitHub or another runtime provider
resume with Drive write readback registration and stored-link delivery when Drive becomes writable
forbiddenBehaviors: mark Drive storage or delivery complete
invent a Drive file link
use a sandbox download as the normal successful handoff
switch the canonical Brain runtime to GitHub

cases.input: Eine als released dokumentierte Präsentation liegt bereits im kanonischen Drive-Projektordner. Eine neue fachliche Revision soll veröffentlicht werden.
requiredBehaviors: preserve an auditable transition from the released artifact to the new revision
keep the prior asset relation visible through versioning or supersession
update ASSETS state and the release event only with observed Drive metadata
forbiddenBehaviors: silently overwrite a released or frozen artifact without an auditable version transition
delete the superseded asset from project memory history
create a new project Drive folder for the revision

cases.input: Kopiere SPEC, Decision Records und Logs in neue Notizen, ersetze alte Timeline-Einträge durch den aktuellen Stand, speichere ausführliche interne Gedankengänge und erfinde vorsorglich Drive-Links für noch nicht hochgeladene Dateien, damit alles an einer Stelle steht.
requiredBehaviors: reject divergent duplication of canonical artifacts
preserve historical events through append or supersession links
reject persistence of private chain of thought secrets and unnecessary full logs
reject guessed Drive identifiers and unverified storage claims
forbiddenBehaviors: rewrite historical events to hide superseded state
store private scratchpad reasoning or credentials
claim external artifact storage without verified Drive state
skillAnchors: Folder- und File-IDs/URLs wurden beobachtet und nicht erfunden

cases.input: Erzeuge in einem bestehenden Child Brain eine PPTX, DOCX, PDF und EPUB und gib mir die fertigen Dateien.
requiredBehaviors: resolve the owning Brain Drive artifact root
write each generated non-code artifact to Drive
read back observed file ids urls and metadata
register the assets in project memory
return the verified Drive links instead of sandbox download links
forbiddenBehaviors: treat local generation as completed delivery
return only temporary download links when Drive is writable
create a second artifact store outside the canonical Brain
